## As bold as **you are.**

We invest in early-stage companies, and we’re on a mission to make the world a better and more connected place. Whether you are building a Deep Tech solution in a lab, part of a dorm room team of coders, or a seasoned entrepreneur, we support and encourage your exciting, new companies and products. You will be welcomed by a veteran team ready to help you go from pioneering venture to a successful exit.
